저연봉 팀들의 돌풍
공교롭게도 MLB 노사는 지금 샐러리캡 도입을 놓고 강대강 대치 중이다. 욕심 많은 구단주들이 야합해 ‘돈 많은 팀만 우승하는 구조를 바꾸자’며 연봉 상한제 도입을 밀어붙이고 있다.
그런데 정작 월드시리즈를 눈앞에 둔 팀들은 대부분 돈 없는 가난뱅이 구단들이다. 연봉총액 1위 뉴욕 메츠는 꼴찌로 추락해 가을야구에도 오르지 못했고, 부자 구단인 뉴욕 양키스와 보스턴 레드삭스, 시카고 컵스도 줄줄이 탈락했다. 심지어 다저스마저 밀워키와의 챔피언십시리즈 1, 2차전을 모두 내주며 벼랑 끝에 몰렸다. 만약 밀워키가 다저스를 꺾는다면 밀워키와 클리블랜드, 혹은 밀워키와 탬파베이의 월드시리즈가 성사된다. 이른바 ‘흥참시(흥행 참패 시리즈)’에 MLB 사무국과 중계 방송사들은 죽을 맛이겠지만, 샐러리캡 반대 진영에는 ‘거 봐라’라며 내세울 강력한 논리가 생긴다.
메이저리그 구단주들의 샐러리캡 도입 기도는 역사가 길다. 각 팀이 선수 연봉에 쓸 수 있는 돈의 상한선을 정해 부자 구단과 가난한 구단의 격차를 줄이겠다는 게 대외적인 취지. 이 그럴싸한 명분을 앞세운 구단주 연합은 1994년에도 샐러리캡 도입을 추진하다 선수노조와 정면충돌했다. 선수들의 파업으로 1994년 월드시리즈가 취소됐고, 이듬해 정규시즌도 단축됐다. 메이저리그 인기는 바닥을 쳤고, 다시 인기를 되찾는 데는 많은 시간과 다량의 금지약물이 필요했다.
오는 12월 기존 노사협약(CBA) 만료를 앞두고는 ‘신 악의 제국’ 다저스 논란이 샐러리캡 도입론에 다시 불을 붙였다. 다저스는 오타니 쇼헤이, 무키 베츠, 프레디 프리먼, 야마모토 요시노부 등 스타들을 끌어모아 2024년과 2025년 월드시리즈를 제패했다. 압도적 자금력으로 최고 선수들을 쓸어담는 다저스 때문에 리그의 경쟁균형이 무너졌다는 게 샐러리캡을 염불처럼 외는 구단주들의 논리다. MLB 사무국은 올해 노사협상에서 2027년부터 팀당 연봉총액 상한선 2억4530만달러, 하한선 1억7120만달러를 적용하는 방안을 제시했다.
하지만 구단주들의 논리가 설득력이 떨어진다는 비판도 만만치 않다. 스포츠매체 디애슬레틱의 켄 로젠탈 선임기자는 밀워키와 클리블랜드, 탬파베이 같은 저연봉 구단들이 꾸준히 좋은 성적을 거두는 사실을 지적하며, 샐러리캡을 시행하는 미 프로풋볼(NFL)과 미 프로농구(NBA)에서도 특정 구단의 장기 집권과 우승 독식이 반복된다고 꼬집었다. 샐러리캡이 반드시 공정한 경쟁을 보장하지는 않는다는 얘기다. 구단 간 수익 배분을 개선하고 돈 안 쓰는 구단주들의 투자를 유도하는 방식을 대안으로 제시한 로젠탈은 구단주들을 향해 “다른 방법으로 야구를 개선하라. 아니면 팀을 팔아버려라”라고 쏘아붙였다.
구단주들은 야구를 개선하거나 팀을 팔 생각도, 샐러리캡을 포기할 생각도 없어 보인다. 경쟁균형은 명분일 뿐, 진짜 목적은 선수 연봉 지출을 줄여 더 많은 돈을 쓸어담는 데 있으니 다른 건 다 내줘도 샐러리캡만은 포기 못 한다.
내년 직장폐쇄 가능성 커
현행 CBA는 미국 동부 기준 오는 12월 1일 만료된다. 새 협약에 합의하지 못하면 구단주들은 직장폐쇄에 돌입할 전망이다. 그러면 2027시즌도 파행을 피하기 어려워진다. 2021년 12월엔 직장폐쇄 99일 만에 새 협약을 체결해 정규시즌을 무사히 치렀지만, 이번에는 샐러리캡이라는 뇌관이 있어 쉽게 풀릴 것 같지 않다. 협상이 길어지면 개막이 늦어지고, 더 길어지면 아예 경기 수가 줄어들 수 있다. 구단주들은 60경기 이상 취소되는 걸 ‘파국’으로 간주한다. 최악의 경우 2027시즌 전체가 날아가는 ‘파멸’이 기다린다. 어쩌면 지금 진행 중인 포스트시즌이 당분간 우리가 볼 마지막 메이저리그 경기가 될지도 모른다.
MLB 사무국은 이미 파멸을 대비하는 분위기다. 디애슬레틱이 입수한 내부 문건에 따르면 사무국은 구단과 리그 관계자들에게 직장폐쇄 대비 지침을 전달했다. 선수들의 구단 시설 이용과 구단 직원의 업무상 연락을 금지하고, 크리스마스 카드나 연말 선물을 보내는 것까지 막는다는 내용이다. 공식 홈페이지에서도 선수들의 사진과 영상이 사라진다. MLB는 2027시즌 경기 취소에 대비해 시즌권 구매자에게 환불이나 적립금을 제공하는 방안까지 마련했다. 최악의 상황도 불사하겠다는 의지가 느껴진다.
메이저리그의 직장폐쇄는 태평양 건너 한국야구에도 영향을 미칠 수 있다. 야구의 세계화 시대에 미국야구에서 벌어지는 일은 더 이상 딴나라 남의 이야기가 아니다. 우선 KBO리그 외국인 선수 수급에 큰 변수가 생길 수 있다. SSG 랜더스의 외국인 투수 페드로 아빌라 사례를 보자. 아빌라는 지난 7월 대체 외국인 선수로 합류해 14경기에서 9승 2패, 평균자책 1.44라는 놀라운 성적을 남겼다. 93.2이닝 동안 삼진 93개를 잡고 두 차례 완투까지 기록하며 SSG 선발진을 이끌었다. 경기 수가 적어서 그렇지 풀시즌 기준으로는 에릭 페디, 코디 폰세급 활약이다.
이 정도 성적이라면 당연히 메이저리그 복귀를 노려볼 만하다. 실제 여러 빅리그 구단이 아빌라를 영입 후보에 올려놓고 관찰해 왔다. 페디, 폰세처럼 거액을 받고 메이저리그로 금의환향하는 게 일반적인 수순이다. 하지만 올해는 다르다. 내년 시즌이 정상적으로 열릴지 불확실한데 자칫 미국행을 택했다가 한 시즌을 통째로 날릴 수도 있다. 아빌라도 이런 사정을 고려해 KBO리그 잔류 쪽으로 기우는 분위기다. 같은 이유에서 지난해까지 한화 이글스에서 뛰었던 라이언 와이스도 한국 복귀를 원하는 것으로 전해졌다.
오타니의 일본 리그 복귀?
한 구단 관계자는 “올겨울 팀들의 외국인 선수 구성이 예년보다 느리게 진행될 것”이라며 “다들 메이저리그 상황을 지켜보며 서두르지 않으려는 분위기”라고 전했다. 예년에는 기존 선수와 재계약도 새 선수 영입도 빠르게 진행하는 게 유리했다면 올해는 기다리는 편이 나을 수 있다. 노사협상이 길어질수록 평소 한국행을 꿈에도 생각하지 않았던 선수들이 시장에 나올 가능성이 있어서다. 빅리그 승격이나 단기 계약을 노리는 선수들로서는 언제 기회가 올지 알 수 없으니, 차라리 한 시즌 계약과 꾸준한 출전이 보장되고 MLB 스카우트들이 매 경기를 지켜보는 KBO리그가 나을 수 있다. 국내 구단들로선 지금까지 ‘감히’ 영입 제안을 건네기 어려웠던 선수들에게도 접근할 기회가 생긴다. 애매한 선수와 섣불리 계약했다간 나중에 후회되는 상황이 생길지도 모른다.
좀 더 극단적인 상황도 상상할 수 있다. 직장폐쇄가 장기화해 2027시즌 MLB가 아예 열리지 않는다면 어떻게 될까. 미국에서 뛰던 정상급 선수들이 한국이나 일본 프로야구에서 한 시즌을 보내는 상황도 생각해 볼 수 있다. 놀랍게도 MLB는 이를 막지 않겠다는 방침이다. 디애슬레틱이 공개한 MLB 문건에는 직장폐쇄 기간 선수들의 다른 프로리그 출전을 제한하지 않겠다는 내용이 담겼다. 일본 프로야구와 윈터리그를 비롯한 국외 프로리그가 대상이니, 당연히 한국도 포함된다.
그렇다면 오타니 쇼헤이, 애런 저지, 폴 스킨스, 타릭 스쿠벌 같은 슈퍼스타들이 한국이나 일본에서 뛰는 일도 가능할까. 이론적으로는 가능한 시나리오다. 애런 저지가 롯데 자이언츠 유니폼을 입고 사직구장 타석에 나오고, 게릿 콜이 한화 이글스 유니폼을 입고 대전 마운드에 오르는, AI 합성물로나 만들 법한 장면을 상상하는 걸 멈추기 어렵다. 물론 한국 구단이 감당하기 어려운 몸값부터 기존 계약과 리그 규약까지 넘어야 할 산이 많아 실현 가능성은 희박해도 팬들로서는 해볼 법한 행복한 상상이다.
MLB 직장폐쇄는 한국인 빅리거들의 진로에도 영향을 미칠 수 있다. 특히 올 시즌을 끝으로 애틀랜타 브레이브스와 계약이 끝난 김하성에게는 민감한 문제다. 김하성은 지난해 12월 애틀랜타와 1년 2000만달러에 계약했다. 올해 좋은 성적으로 FA 대박 계약을 따내겠다는 구상이었지만 기대에 크게 못 미쳤다. 올해 성적으로는 장기 계약은커녕 마이너리그 계약을 걱정해야 한다는 게 현지 평가. 여기에 내년 시즌의 정상 개최 여부도 불확실해 김하성이 한시적인 국내 복귀를 고려할 수 있다는 전망도 조금씩 나온다. 미국에서 언제 될지 모르는 계약을 기다리느니 한국에서 한 시즌을 뛰며 경기 감각을 되찾고, 상황이 정리된 뒤 메이저리그에 재도전한다는 시나리오다. 이 경우 원소속팀 키움 히어로즈가 우선적인 권리를 갖는다.
키움 우승후보 될 수도
여기서 상상력을 더 발휘하면 정말 흥미로운 그림이 나온다. 현재 미국에서 뛰는 이정후·김혜성·송성문의 KBO리그 일시 복귀 가능성이다. 만약 직장폐쇄가 장기화하고 MLB 구단과 계약한 선수들의 한국 리그 일시 출전까지 허용된다면 어떨까. KBO가 특수한 상황을 고려해 한국인 메이저리거의 원소속팀 한시 복귀를 허용하는 특별 규정까지 마련한다면, 김하성·이정후·김혜성·송성문이 내년 시즌 키움에서 다시 뭉치는 상황도 생각해 볼 수 있다. 4년 연속 최하위에 머문 키움이 하루아침에 우승후보가 되는 상황이다.
물론 가정에 가정을 더하고 상상에 상상을 더해야 가능한 이야기다. 하지만 메이저리그가 실제 직장폐쇄에 돌입하고 2027시즌마저 날아가는, 아무도 가보지 않은 길에 접어든다면 무슨 일이 생길지 모른다. 미국의 야구가 멈추는 순간, 한국야구에도 지금까지 경험하지 못한 일들이 벌어질 수 있다. 올 초 기자에게 “직장폐쇄 가능성이 50 대 50”이라고 했던 미국 구단 관계자는 최근 다시 물었을 때 “90%”라고 답했다.

item.title: [Sports Illustrated] Latest Dodgers Prediction Gives Tigers Hope for a Tarik Skubal Reunion
item.dc:creator: Alvin Garcia; Unknown

item.content:encoded:
The Detroit Tigers have another reason to consider bringing Tarik Skubal home as questions grow about his future with the Los Angeles Dodgers.
In ESPN’s offseason outlook, Alden Gonzalez predicts no massive Skubal extension with the Dodgers before Dec. 1.
His forecast centers on uncertainty over MLB’s next economic system as the collective bargaining agreement approaches expiration and a potential lockout looms. It is a prediction about timing, not a confirmed decision that Los Angeles will never offer Skubal a contract.
For the Tigers, that creates a possibility worth exploring. A cautious bidder could leave room for Detroit to act, particularly if Skubal wants his future settled before a work stoppage.
The available evidence supports a plausible reunion. Making it happen still requires an offer competitive enough to overcome the rest of the market.
Why a Skubal Reunion Remains Realistic
Skubal has already supplied the strongest personal reason to take the possibility seriously.
"I would love to return," he said during an August appearance on Pardon My Take, as Tigers On SI covered when examining his free-agency hopes.
Those comments came after Detroit traded him to Los Angeles. The separation clearly did not eliminate his interest in the organization where he developed into a two-time American League Cy Young Award winner.
A return would also give the Tigers an appealing outcome: bringing back their former ace while retaining the players acquired in the trade. That would strengthen the rotation without requiring another prospect package.
The market assessment comes with a qualification, however. In his Oct. 2 survey of industry insiders, ESPN’s Kiley McDaniel included Detroit among possible contenders alongside the Dodgers and New York Mets. He also noted that insiders more often viewed the Tigers as being on the periphery.
That distinction matters when assessing their actual chances. There is a credible connection between the player and the team, but the public reporting provides little basis for treating Detroit as the favorite.
Skubal’s willingness to return gives the front office a reason to engage. It does not establish that he will accept less money to do so.
Detroit’s Biggest Hurdle Is the Financial Commitment
McDaniel’s 27 contract projections averaged eight years and $355 million. That is an industry forecast rather than a reported asking price, but it illustrates the scale of the potential commitment.
The Tigers have demonstrated a willingness to invest in starting pitching. Their three-year, $115 million agreement with Framber Valdez represents a substantial expenditure. A deal approaching Skubal’s projected guarantee would require a much longer commitment and more than three times that total.
There is also a broader roster to build. President of baseball operations Scott Harris has described free agency as a way to supplement Detroit’s developing core. A Skubal pursuit would test how aggressively ownership is willing to fund that approach while leaving resources for additional improvements.
The labor uncertainty affecting Los Angeles also applies to Detroit. The Tigers cannot assume that waiting for new economic rules will produce a cheaper ace, or that other bidders will remain cautious.
Their clearest path is a competitive offer early enough to matter. If Detroit authorizes a guarantee near the market’s upper end, Skubal’s affection for the city gives the club something meaningful to build on.
If the plan depends on a substantial hometown discount, the Dodgers’ hesitation offers limited help.
A reunion deserves serious consideration. Detroit’s chances ultimately depend on whether its financial commitment matches its former ace’s interest in coming back.
Alvin Garcia is a Puerto Rico-born sportswriter and U.S. Army veteran. He has covered Major League Baseball since 2022, producing breaking news, game coverage, analysis, roster stories and player features for national and team-focused publications. His previous work has appeared at Heavy, The Sporting News, Athlon Sports, Yardbarker, and FanSided. Garcia brings a data-informed, fan-focused approach to his coverage.

item.title: [Yahoo Sports] Yankees Named Top Landing Spot For Tarik Skubal Entering Offseason
item.dc:creator: Matt Levine
item.description: The New York Yankees saw their playoff lives come crashing down in the American League Division Series to the Tampa Bay Rays. After sweeping the Boston Red Sox in the wild-card series, New York was swept by Tampa Bay. This now sends the Yankees into a tough offseason, filled with all sorts of questions around the organization. item.content:encoded:
The New York Yankees saw their playoff lives come crashing down in the American League Division Series to the Tampa Bay Rays.
After sweeping the Boston Red Sox in the wild-card series, New York was swept by Tampa Bay. This now sends the Yankees into a tough offseason, filled with all sorts of questions around the organization.
New York did play the series against Tampa Bay without star Aaron Judge due to injury, giving the team some leeway. But the early postseason exit just marks another season where the Yankees didn't win the World Series.
And as the team enters the offseason, the front office has a lot of work to do to fix the roster. The starting pitching was the strength of this team all season, but the Yankees could elect to keep diving into it.
One name that could make some sense for New York to go after is ace Tarik Skubal, who split time between the Detroit Tigers and Los Angeles Dodgers this year. Skubal is seen by many as one of the best pitchers in baseball, and he will be hitting free agency this offseason.
MLB analyst Zachary D. Rymer of Bleacher Report linked the Yankees to Skubal, listing them as a top landing spot. New York is one of the few teams across baseball that may be willing to give the lefty ace the type of contract that he desires in free agency.
Many are expecting Skubal to receive over $300 million in free agency, but whether the Yankees would e willing to pay this remains to be seen. Skubal could add to a rotation that has Cam Schlittler, Max Fried, Gerrit Cole and Carlos Rodon, giving New York the best group in baseball.
Cole is getting older and he wasn't as effective this year, so the Skubal argument could make sense. The left-hander was very good again this season, even with him missing time due to an injury.
Skubal posted a 2.72 ERA over 26 starts between the two teams, while striking out 186 batters over 158.2 innings. The left-hander remained dominant on the mound, and he has more than earned a massive payday this offseason.
New York could be a solid landing spot for Skubal, giving him the chance to play in the biggest city that the sport has to offer. But the Yankees will have competition to sign Skubal this offseason, which could see a bidding war take place.

item.dc:creator: Michael DeRosa

item.content:encoded:
The New York Mets are going to be one of baseball's most fascinating teams to watch this offseason.
After underperforming in such a significant way this season, the expectation is that the Mets will be very active in free agency. It is understandable, as they want to be contenders and have a lot of work to do with their roster to become that.
One of the biggest rumors surrounding the Mets is their expected pursuit of Los Angeles Dodgers superstar pitcher Tarik Skubal. It is very easy to understand why New York is being linked to him. They desperately need pitching help, and Skubal is baseball's best pitcher. Thus, the Mets making a major push for him this offseason simply makes sense.
Now, with the Dodgers getting swept by the Milwaukee Brewers in the NLCS, the Mets have gotten a very good prediction regarding the Skubal sweepstakes.
New York Mets Get Great Tarik Skubal Update Before MLB Free Agency
In a recent Bleacher Report article, Zachary D. Rymer named the Mets as the "top contender" to land Skubal this offseason in free agency.
"The Mets are the top contender for Skubal because of course they are. Steve Cohen may not be MLB's richest owner anymore, but his track record speaks for itself," Rymer wrote.
"Under him, the Mets have had MLB's No. 1 Opening Day payroll in three of the last four years. And while president of baseball operations David Stearns clearly falls on the risk-averse side, Cohen has been known to put his finger on the scale until it climbs all the way to $765 million. That was for Juan Soto, of course, and there's no denying that the Mets need his equal on the mound. Their starting rotation was a disaster this year, ranking 23rd in ERA and rWAR," Rymer added.
Seeing the Mets be named the most likely team to land Skubal right now is certainly encouraging. It is also understandable, as they are in desperate need of a true superstar pitcher. Due to this and New York's desperation to be contenders, it would not be shocking if they make a major push for Skubal this offseason.
Mets Landing Skubal Could Be Game-Changing
If the Mets landed Skubal this offseason, it could be game-changing. He is baseball's top pitcher and would significantly improve New York's starting rotation. This would undoubtedly help the Mets' chances of being a playoff team again next offseason because of it.
Skubal is a two-time Cy Young Award winner who was once again great this season. In 26 games in 2026, he had a 12-7 record, a 2.72 ERA, and 186 strikeouts. This marked the fourth season in a row that he had a 2.80 ERA or lower. With this, he would be a spectacular pickup for the Mets if brought in.
This article was originally published on HEAVY
The post New York Mets Get Great Tarik Skubal Update Before MLB Free Agency appeared first on HEAVY.

item.content:encoded:
La tensión ha alcanzado su punto más alto en la Serie de Campeonato de la Liga Americana (ALCS). Tras tres intensos compromisos repletos de emociones, dramatismo y béisbol del más alto nivel, los Cleveland Guardians se colocaron a una sola victoria de conquistar el gallardete del joven circuito e instalarse en la Serie Mundial 2026. Por su parte, los Tampa Bay Rays afrontan este crucial Juego 4 sin margen de error, obligados a ganar para mantener con vida sus aspiraciones y forzar la extensión del compromiso.
La novena de Cleveland, que firmó una postemporada memorable tras venir de atrás en las rondas previas, se presenta a este cuarto capítulo con el viento a su favor y la posibilidad de terminar la obra en casa.
Sin embargo, enfrente tienen a una escuadra de Tampa Bay caracterizada por su resiliencia y capacidad estratégica para levantarse en momentos de máxima exigencia. Todo está servido para una batalla campal sobre el diamante en la que un error podría definir el destino de toda una campaña.
Así se han vivido los primeros tres partidos de la ALCS
El camino hacia este Juego 4 ha estado marcado por finales apretados y giros de tuerca constantes que han mantenido a la afición al borde del asiento.
Juego 1: golpe de autoridad visitante de Cleveland
El primer enfrentamiento de la serie en el Tropicana Field arrancó con un duelo táctico desde el montículo. Los Guardians lograron romper el cero en la quinta entrada gracias a la oportunidad de su parte baja del orden al bate. Pese a una tardía reacción de las mantarrayas en los episodios finales, el cerrador de Cleveland bajó la cortina para asegurar el triunfo por pizarra de 3-2, arrebatándole de inmediato la ventaja de localía a Tampa Bay.
Juego 2: dominio absoluto del pitcheo abridor
Para el segundo capítulo de la contienda, la rotación de los Guardians volvió a dar una lección de efectividad. Maniatando por completo a los maderos estelares de los Rays, el abridor de Cleveland trabajó seis entradas completas sin permitir anotación, recetando ocho ponches. Con un rally de tres carreras impulsado por extrabases consecutivos en la séptima entrada, Cleveland se impuso 4-1, poniendo la serie 2-0 a su favor y dejando desorientada a la escuadra floridana antes de viajar a Ohio.
Juego 3: La respuesta de orgullo y poder de Tampa Bay
Obligados a responder para no quedar al borde del abismo en suelo ajeno, los Rays mostraron su mejor versión en el tercer compromiso. Con un ataque agresivo desde el primer inning que incluyó un cuadrangular con hombres en base, la ofensiva de Tampa Bay descifró los lanzamientos del abridor rival. Aunque Cleveland intentó acortar distancias en el tramo final del juego, el relevo de las mantarrayas aguantó el embate para sellar el triunfo 6-4, recortando la diferencia en la serie (2-1) y extendiendo el duelo a un cuarto capítulo obligado.
El impacto de Jonathan Aranda: Los números del mexicano en la Serie de Campeonato
En medio de la intensa contienda por el banderín de la Liga Americana, la figura del infielder mexicano Jonathan Aranda ha destacado de forma sobresaliente en el line-up de los Tampa Bay Rays, consolidándose como uno de los bateadores más consistentes y oportunos del equipo durante esta fase de playoffs.
El tijuanaense ha asumido la responsabilidad de encabezar la ofensiva de su escuadra en los momentos de mayor presión. A lo largo de los primeros tres encuentros de la Serie de Campeonato, Aranda presume registros individuales de alto impacto:
- Promedio de Bateo (AVG): .364 en la serie (4 imparables en 11 turnos oficiales al bate).
- Cuadrangulares: 1 jonrón clave conectado durante el Juego 3 que inició la remontada de los Rays.
- Carreras Producidas: 3 carreras impulsadas, manteniéndose como el líder del equipo en este rubro durante la ALCS.
- Porcentaje de Embasado (OBP): .462, producto de su paciencia en la caja de bateo tras negociar dos pasaportes vitales.
La disciplina de Aranda frente a los lanzadores de Cleveland ha sido determinante para dar vueltas a la alineación y generar oportunidades de anotación. De cara al Juego 4, la aportación ofensiva del toletero mexicano será indispensable si Tampa Bay pretende descifrar el pitcheo rival y empatar la serie.
¿Cuándo, a qué hora y dónde ver en vivo desde México el Juego 4?
El cuarto duelo de esta vibrante Serie de Campeonato entre Cleveland Guardians y Tampa Bay Rays se jugará este viernes y contará con cobertura televisiva y digital completa para los aficionados en territorio mexicano.
A continuación, los datos confirmedos para dar seguimiento en vivo al encuentro:
- Fecha: Viernes 16 de octubre de 2026.
- Horario (Tiempo del Centro de México): 18:08 horas.
- Sede: Progressive Field, Cleveland, Ohio.
- Transmisión por Televisión (México): El partido se transmitirá en directo por televisión de paga a través de las señales de ESPN y Fox Sports México.
- Transmisión por Streaming: Disponible en plataformas digitales mediante Disney+ (sección de Deportes) y la aplicación de Fox Sports, así como a través del servicio oficial MLB.TV para los suscriptores de la liga.

item.title: [roundtable.io] Boston Red Sox Starter Nominated for Players’ Choice Award
item.dc:creator: Zach Coe
item.description: Sonny Gray impressed in his first, and maybe only, season in Boston. When the Boston Red Sox acquired Sonny Gray in an offseason deal with the St. Louis Cardinals, they were met with plenty of skepticism about whether or not the 36-year-old veteran could pitch in a big market like Boston after struggling during his time in New York as a member of the Yankees, and whether he could recapture his front-of-the-rotation form this late in his career. item.content:encoded:
Sonny Gray impressed in his first, and maybe only, season in Boston.
When the Boston Red Sox acquired Sonny Gray in an offseason deal with the St. Louis Cardinals, they were met with plenty of skepticism about whether or not the 36-year-old veteran could pitch in a big market like Boston after struggling during his time in New York as a member of the Yankees, and whether he could recapture his front-of-the-rotation form this late in his career. Those two questions he answered emphatically, posting one of the best seasons of his career.
In 29 starts for Boston, Gray posted a 2.72 ERA, the fifth-lowest among qualified American League starters and the eighth-lowest among qualified starters in baseball. In addition to posting the second-lowest ERA of his career, Gray finished the season tied for the league lead in wins with 18. Gray’s career renaissance was especially important in 2026, as the Red Sox lost 2025 American League Cy Young Award runner-up Garrett Crochet to a left shoulder injury on April 26, which ended his regular season. In Crochet’s absence, Gray and rookie Payton Tolle helped carry the Red Sox pitching staff to the third-lowest team ERA in baseball.
As a result of his career renaissance season, Gray has earned a nod of respect from his peers, being named one of the three finalists for the American League’s Most Outstanding Pitcher at the MLB Players’ Choice Awards. Gray is joined by New York Yankees starter Cam Schlittler and Toronto Blue Jays ace Dylan Cease. No surprises among the trio named finalists, as they could very well be the same three named finalists for the American League Cy Young Award.
After putting his name on the map with a dominant Game 3 performance against the Red Sox in the 2025 Wild Card series, Schlittler’s second act was somehow better than his postseason performance. In 33 starts for New York, the Walpole, Mass. native posted a 1.95 ERA, the lowest among all qualified American League starters and second-lowest among all qualified starters in the sport. His spectacular sophomore season is likely to earn him the AL Cy Young Award.
Cease posted an almost equally impressive first season in Toronto. In 29 starts, the 30-year-old right-hander posted a 2.40 ERA, trailing only Schlittler in the American League, and the fourth-lowest mark among all qualified starters in the sport. Cease also continued his run as one of the most prolific strikeout pitchers in the sport, punching out 12.73 batters per nine innings, leading the American League and trailing only Milwaukee Brewers ace and likely National League Cy Young Award winner Jacob Misiorowski for the league lead.
The MLB Players' Choice Award winners will be announced during the week of Oct. 26.
Of note
With the Red Sox officially in offseason mode, Zach Coe and David Azer are back on the 'Entering Kenmore' Podcast discussing how close Boston is to winning a World Series, offseason needs, and whether or not the 2026 season was successful. Check it out wherever you get your podcasts, or in the YouTube player below:

item.dc:creator: Tom Dakers
item.description: 2026 was the final season of Kevin Gausman's five-year, $110 million free-agent contract. In the first four seasons, Kevin posted a 48-41 record, a 3.48 ERA, and an 11.5 bWAR. A good return on a big free-agent contract. Not all that many of those go as well as this one did. But 2026 was his age-35 season, and sometimes pitchers don't do well in their mid-30s. | Age | Team | WAR | W | L | ERA | G | GS | IP | H | R | ER | HR | BB | IBB | SO | HBP | BK | WP | BF | ERA+ | FIP | | 35 | 2TM | 1.1 | 9
item.content:encoded:
2026 was the final season of Kevin Gausman's five-year, $110 million free-agent contract. In the first four seasons, Kevin posted a 48-41 record, a 3.48 ERA, and an 11.5 bWAR. A good return on a big free-agent contract. Not all that many of those go as well as this one did.
But 2026 was his age-35 season, and sometimes pitchers don't do well in their mid-30s.
| Age | Team | WAR | W | L | ERA | G | GS | IP | H | R | ER | HR | BB | IBB | SO | HBP | BK | WP | BF | ERA+ | FIP |
| 35 | 2TM | 1.1 | 9 | 12 | 4.51 | 32 | 32 | 177.2 | 179 | 96 | 89 | 26 | 47 | 1 | 184 | 1 | 3 | 2 | 750 | 97 | 3.74 |
| 35 | TOR | 1.0 | 5 | 10 | 4.38 | 23 | 23 | 127.1 | 128 | 68 | 62 | 15 | 36 | 1 | 127 | 1 | 3 | 1 | 540 | 101 | 3.51 |
| 35 | CHC | 0.1 | 4 | 2 | 4.83 | 9 | 9 | 50.1 | 51 | 28 | 27 | 11 | 11 | 0 | 57 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 210 | 88 | 4.33 |
Provided by Baseball-Reference.com: View Original Table
Generated 10/15/2026.
Baseball Reference has him at a 1.1 WAR (down from 4.0). FanGraphs 3.1 (down from 4.1), giving him a value of $25.1 million to the Jays and Cubs.
He had a 3.3.74 FIP and a 3.58 xFIP, which is why the FanGraphs WAR is so much better than the Baseball Reference one.
Kevin's BABIP was .311 (up from.262 last year). 68.7% of his base runner were stranded (down from 72.2%).
His line drive rate was down a little bit (19.6% from 21.3 last year), ground ball rate up (40.3% down from 36.7), and fly ball rate much the same (40.3% from 42.0). 12.7% of fly balls hit off him left the park, up from 9.5.
His strikeout rate about the same (24.5% from 24.4), and his walk rate was down a bit (6.3% from 6.5).
Kevin's soft contact was up (17.4% from 15.1 last year) and hard contact about the same (35.9% from 36.2).
He was better against LHB (.251/.304/.389) than RHB (.269/.307/.459). He's been slightly better against LHB for his career.
He was better at home (3.83 ERA, batters hit .264/.299/.439) than on the road (5.40, .253/.313/.394).
Kevin was better in the first half of the season (4.33, .244/.296/.405) than the second half (4.82, .284/.320/.444).
Gausman by month:
- April: 7 starts, 2-2, 3.10. Batters hit .204/.244/.349, 5 home runs, 8 walks and 40 strikeouts.
- May: 5 starts, 2-1, 3.18. Batters hit .291/.316/.364, 1 home run, 4 walks and 26 strikeouts.
- June: 6 starts, 0-4, 6.47. Batters hit .262/.324/.556, 9 home runs, 12 walks and 34 strikeouts.
- July: 4 starts, 0-3, 6.10. Batters hit .280/.366/.317, 3 home runs, 11 walks and 23 strikeouts.
- August: 6 starts, 4-1, 4.54. Batters hit .275/.312/.443, 5 home runs, 8 walks and 33 strikeouts.
- September: 4 starts, 1-1, 4.43. Batters hit .267/.298/.478, 6 home runs, 4 walks and 28 strikeouts.
The Jays were 9-14 in his starts. The Cubs were 5-4 in his starts. Between the two teams, they averaged 4.05 runs scored in games he started. They scored 2 or less runs in 13 of his starts.
Days of rest:
- 4 days, 12 games: 3.54, .246/.288/.404.
- 5 days, 16 games: 5.26, .265/.313/.433.
- 6 or more days, 4 games: 4.50, .275/.326/.413
I love guys who are best on normal rest. I think we are all creatures of habit, you get in a routine and things go well, you leave that routine and they don't got as well. He was also best on normal rest last year.
Times through the order:
- 1st: Batters hit .233/.276/.346.
- 2nd: Batters hit .270/.318/.460.
- 3rd: Batters hit .286/.333/.478.
- And he faced 1 batter a fourth time, getting the out.
I wonder if he would consider being a reliever next year? That might be reading too much into one season, in 2025 he was pretty much the same for each of the first three times through the order.
By Catcher:
- Brandon Valenzuela: 4.46, .254/.298/.396 in 308 PA.
- Alejandro Kirk: 4.81, .263/.324/.419 in 185 PA.
- Carson Kelly: 4.20, .226/.268/.426 in 123 PA.
- Miguel Amaya: 5.75, .305/.333/.500 in 87 PA.
- Tyler Heineman: 2.31, .273/.319/.409 in 47 PA.
Kevin's best start, by GameScore, was a 78 on April 1st, at home against the Rockies. He went 6 innings, 2 hits, 0 earned runs, 0 walks, and 10 strikeouts. He also had a 77 and two 76s.
Worst start? A 13 in Chicago against the Cubs, on June 19th. You likely remember it: 2 innings, 7 hits, 7 earned runs, 1 home run, 4 walks and 3 strikeouts. We used six relievers, two days after a bullpen day, and the next day Patrick Corbin was pulled after 3.2 innings.
Kevin averaged 5.5 innings per start in his 23 starts with us. And about the same in his 9 starts with the Cubs. His one playoff start didn't go all that well: 3.1 innings, 3 earned.
He threw, for the most part, three pitches:
- Four Seamer: 93.8 mph (last year it averaged 94.5). Batters hit .289 against it (.230 last year).
- Split finger: 84 mph (last year it averaged 94.9). Batters hit .207 against it (.191 last year).
- Slider: 84.1 mph (last year it averaged 83.2). Batters hit .324 against it (.333 last year).
Random Baseball Savant numbers:
- Fastball Run Value: 87th percentile.
- Breaking Ball Run Value: 7th percentile.
- Chase Rate: 88th percentile.
- Strikeout %: 70th percentile.
- Walk %: 86th percentile.
- Barrell %: 46th percentile.
- Hard Hit %: 34th percentile.
- Expected ERA: 53rd percentile.
With the Jays, he posted a 53-51 record and a 3.63 ERA, with a 12.5 bWAR (and a 21 fWAR). FanGraphs says he was worth $167.6 million over his five-year contract, and he was paid $110 million, so we got more than our money's worth.
On the Jays career leaderboard:
- 11th in pitcher bWAR: 12.5.
- 7th in ERA: 3.62
- 11th in wins: 53 (tied with Jose Berrios)
- 11th in innings pitched: 861.0.
- 7th in strikeouts: 920.
- 9th in games started: 148.
He also started 7 playoff games (and pitched once in relief) for the Jays. He had a 3.79 ERA and a 2-4 record.
The last I saw, Gausman was talking about retirement, but he has said that he would consider coming back to the Jays. As I mentioned above, he was terrific the first time through the order, and far less good the second and third times. But I'm not sure that he would want to come back to pitch out of the pen.
The trade looks very good for the Jays, Brett Bateman was terrific for us, in his 41 games. Ty Southisene played well for 11 games with Vancouver, hitting .262/.380/.429. It will be interesting to watch how he does. FanGraphs had him listed as the Cubs 27th best prospect. He's fast and plays good defense in the middle of the infield.
It was great getting to watch Gausman pitch. The last five seasons wouldn't have been nearly as much fun without him.

item.title: [jaysjournal.com] What Blue Jays fans need to know about a potential MLB lockout
item.dc:creator: Edward Eng
item.description: The current MLB Collective Bargaining Agreement is set to expire on December 1 at 11:59 pm EST. When that happens, and if a new agreement hasn’t been reached, it would trigger a potential lockout of the players. This would prevent teams from performing any more baseball activities and transactions. How will this affect the Toronto Blue Jays? The Blue Jays fully intend to bolster their roster this winter as they will look to contend again in 2027. But the next CBA could play a major role in just
item.content:encoded:
The current MLB Collective Bargaining Agreement is set to expire on December 1 at 11:59 pm EST. When that happens, and if a new agreement hasn’t been reached, it would trigger a potential lockout of the players. This would prevent teams from performing any more baseball activities and transactions.
How will this affect the Toronto Blue Jays? The Blue Jays fully intend to bolster their roster this winter as they will look to contend again in 2027. But the next CBA could play a major role in just exactly how they will be able to build their team in order to do that.
Changes the Blue Jays could have to navigate under a new CBA
Qualifying offers being made to pending free agents
With the qualifying offer period taking place in November, teams are expected to make those offers to players as usual. No qualifying offers expected to be handed out by Toronto this offseason, as per Sportsnet. Players such as George Springer, Shane Bieber and Max Scherzer are all likely to be free to test free agency.
The signing of free agents and making trades
Business should proceed as normal in terms of organizations looking to make acquisitions for their roster. However, with baseball activities highly expected to be halted by Dec. 1, some insiders expect plenty of action to take place during the month of November, before any new rules are set within the new CBA.
The tendering of contracts to arbitration-eligible players
The lockout shouldn’t influence teams in any way in tendering contracts to players potentially heading to arbitration. In the case of the Blue Jays, they have eight players that fall into this category: Davis Schneider, Louis Varland, Nathan Lukes, Spencer Arrighetti, Bowden Francis, Josh Smith, Ernie Clement and José Soriano. Toronto will tender contracts to those they believe will be a key part of their future, regardless of the pending lockout.
The MLB Winter Meetings and Draft Lottery
The MLB Winter Meetings and the Draft Lottery typically take place during the first half of December, so both major events could be cancelled if a new deal isn't reached. Usually some of the biggest signings and trades take place when the teams’ GMs meet at the Winter Meetings.
This further encourages all teams, including the Blue Jays, to execute their impactful moves prior to December. Toronto also won’t know where they will be drafting in 2027 until after the CBA is agreed upon, which could impact their future plans on potential draft candidates to consider.
The Rule 5 Draft
The Rule 5 Draft is likely the aspect that will have an effect on the Blue Jays the most. By Nov. 17 at, teams must put Rule 5 eligible players on their 40-man roster to protect them from being selected at the draft, which usually takes place in December.
If a lockout doesn’t occur, the Rule 5 Draft will proceed as normal. But if a lockout occurs, the draft will be cancelled and may not take place this offseason at all.
The Blue Jays must decide if they should approach it with a "business as usual" approach or do they try and get a little bit creative and assume a lockout will occur. The Jays have key top prospects such as Nolan Perry, Gage Stanifer, Daniel Guerra, Jay Harry, Josh Kasevich and others that are Rule 5 eligible this offseason.
To protect a fair number of them, they would need a considerable amount of spots on the 40-man roster to house them. But if Toronto gambles and hopes that a Rule 5 Draft doesn’t take place at all, they could risk putting fewer of those young players on the 40-man list and keep spots open for other players. The downside is, if they do that and the Rule 5 Draft does end up taking place, the Blue Jays will risk losing some of their top prospects.

item.content:encoded:
The Philadelphia Phillies have locked in their manager after removing the interim tag from Don Mattingly. Who their regular shortstop will be during season is a question that Trea Turner will have to answer.
The 33-year-old Turner was challenged this week by Phillies president of baseball operations Dave Dombrowski to improve his defense, otherwise Turner will be taking on a new position within the team.
"From a defensive perspective we were very clear," Dombrowski said of his conversation with Turner. "He knows he has to be better at shortstop. And I told him that it's really mandatory that he's like that. He feels he can play, and if he plays shortstop like he did in '25, he can play shortstop. But if he plays it like he did in '26, he can't. And he totally understands that."
Turner committed 21 errors during the 2026 season, the second-highest season total of his 12-year MLB career. His highest amount came in 2023, his first season with the Phillies. According to MLB, his -10 Outs Above Average this past season was 39th out of 42 qualified shortstops. That is a vast drop off from his +17 OAA in 2025, which was third-best.
Defensive issues were a season-long storyline for Turner, who played 154 games at shortstop. While Mattingly spoke with several other players, including Bryce Harper, about changing positions, no conversations were held with Turner.
The Phillies have options if the time comes where Turner needs a position change. Bryson Stott played shortstop before Turner joined in Dec. 2022. Prospects Aidan Miller and Bryan Rincon could end up there later on in the 2027 season. There is also free agency if Dombrowski wants to find cover before Spring Training — barring a lockout, of course.
There are seven years and $190 million remaining on Turner's contract, which includes a no-trade clause.
"I can't control the daily banter about what takes place," Dombrowski said. "He's not the first player I've ever been around that was surrounded by that. He's a smart guy. He knows he needs to get better, and I think he'll deal with it. But he's got a long time to be here."

item.title: [PCMag] Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Milwaukee Brewers Livestream: How to Watch Today's MLB NLDS Game 4, Even for Free
item.dc:creator: Jason Cohen

item.content:encoded:
As summer comes to a close and the air turns crisp, you know what's coming: the MLB Playoffs. The NFL season is already underway, and if you're also a baseball lover, this next month is essential viewing. The MLB has been through a number of changes in recent years. From the universal DH and the pitch clock to video replay and an automated strike zone, baseball may look very different if you haven't been paying attention.
Earlier today, the Guardians took on the Rays, and tonight, the Dodgers will go head-to-head against the Brewers in the best-of-seven Championship series. Which team will come out on top? Here's how you can watch live.
What Time Is the Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Milwaukee Brewers Game?
Today's game between the Dodgers and Brewers will take place on Thursday, October 15 at 9 p.m. ET.
How to Watch the Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Milwaukee Brewers?
Tonight's Dodgers vs. Brewers game will air on Fox and FS1. This year, the American League Division Series games will be broadcast on TBS, while the National League games will be on Fox and FS1. You can also watch them with a live TV or sports streaming subscription from DirecTV, Fox One, Fubo, HBO Max, Hulu, Sling, Sportsnet+ (if you're in Canada), or YouTube TV.
How to Watch the Dodgers vs. the Brewers for Free
If you don't want to subscribe to any of the above platforms, you may be able to sign up for a few free trials to gain access to this weekend's games. Fox One and Hulu offer three-day trials, DirecTV and Fubo offer five days, and YouTube TV gives you 10 days for free.
2026 MLB Playoffs Game Schedule
MLB's expanded postseason means more teams on the playoff schedule. Things started off with the best-of-three Wild Card Series, where the Braves, Padres, White Sox, and Yankees advanced. The best-of-five Division Series put them up against the Los Angeles Dodgers, Milwaukee Brewers, Cleveland Guardians, and Tampa Bay Rays, respectively. All of whom managed to advance
Now, the Rays and Guardians and Dodgers and Brewers meet in the best-of-seven Championship Series to determine the best team in each league. The winner from each league will then advance to a best-of-seven World Series to begin on October 23. Who will make it all the way?
Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Milwaukee Brewers - MIL lead 3-0
- Game 4 on October 15 @ 9 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1
- Game 5 on October 16 @ 9 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1*
- Game 6 on October 18 @ 8 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1*
- Game 7 on October 19 @ 8 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1*
Cleveland Guardians vs. Tampa Bay Rays - CLE leads 1-1
- Game 3 on October 15 @ 1 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max
- Game 4 on October 16 @ 6 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max
- Game 5 on October 17 @ 8 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max*
- Game 6 on October 19 @ 5 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max*
- Game 7 on October 20 @ 8 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max*
*if necessary
How to Stream the 2026 MLB Playoffs
This year's MLB postseason is stretched across multiple networks and streaming services. All Wild Card Series games for the American League and National League were broadcast on NBC, NBCSN, and Peacock. Additional rounds will be on other networks. ALDS and ALCS games are on TBS/TruTV and HBO Max, while NLDS and NLCS games are on Fox/FS1. For the World Series, all games will be broadcast on Fox and the Fox One streaming service.
- DirecTV: DirecTV's MySports base pack costs $45 per month for the first six months to see every game on Fox, FS1, NBC, and TBS/TruTV.
- Fox One: Fox's own streaming app lets you watch the NLDS, NLCS, and World Series on Fox and FS1 for $20 per month.
- Fubo: Fubo's Sports plan costs $45.99 for the first month to watch the Wild Card Series, NLDS, NLCS, and World Series on Fox, FS1, and NBC/NBCSN.
- HBO Max: If you pay for the $18.49-per-month HBO Max Standard, you'll be able to watch the ALDS and ALCS games on TBS/TruTV.
- Hulu: For $90 per month, you can watch every game on Fox, FS1, NBC, TBS, and TruTV.
- Peacock: Instead of a live TV service, you'd need to pay $10.99 per month for Peacock Premium to see the Wild Card Series games.
- Sling: The $60.99-per-month Sling Orange & Blue bundle will let you watch the ALDS and ALCS on TBS/TruTV and the NLDS and NLCS on FS1. Day Passes are also available for Sling Orange, allowing you to watch games on TBS for up to seven days.
- Sportsnet+ (Canada only): The $30-per-month Standard tier lets you watch every postseason game.
- YouTube TV: Though the standard plan for YouTube TV costs $83 per month, you can actually now pay for the cheaper $65 Sports package to see all games on Fox, FS1, NBC/NBCSN, and TBS/TruTV.
Can I Watch Postseason Games on MLB.TV?
Are you already an MLB.TV subscriber? You can watch the Division Series, Championship Series, and World Series games through MLB's own streaming service—but there's a catch. To watch on MLB.TV, you'll first need to authenticate through a participating pay TV provider. It's such a sticking point that it makes the entire question moot. If you already have a TV provider, then you wouldn't need to use a streaming service. If you don't already have an MLB.TV subscription, don't pay for one now.
How can I listen to the 2026 postseason?
You can also listen to the games via ESPN Radio.
Which Teams Are In the Playoffs?
Since MLB expanded its postseason picture in 2022, a total of 12 teams make the playoffs each year. That includes six teams per league, including the three division winners and three Wild Card teams.
- American League Division Winners: Tampa Bay Rays (1), Cleveland Guardians (2), Houston Astros (3)
- American League Wild Card: New York Yankees (4), Boston Red Sox (5), Chicago White Sox (6)
- National League Division Winners: Milwaukee Brewers (1), Los Angeles Dodgers (2), Atlanta Braves (3)
- National League Wild Card: Chicago Cubs (4), Philadelphia Phillies (5), San Diego Padres (6)
Upgrade Your Streaming Experience
If you decide to watch the MLB postseason, there's still time to get a big-screen television for viewing this beautiful game. Pro tip: Turn on your TV's motion-smoothing option for the best picture while watching sports. Just remember to turn it off before watching other TV shows and movies to avoid the awful "soap opera" effect.
About Our Expert
As PCMag's editor of how to content, I have to cover a wide variety of topics and also make our stories accessible to everyday users. Considering my history as a technical writer, copywriter, and all-around freelancer covering baseball, comics, and more at various outlets, I am used to making myself into an expert.
I believe tech corporations are bad, but you might as well know how to use technology in everyday life. Want more how to content delivered right to your inbox? Sign up for the tips and tricks newsletter that I curate three times a week.
My job as how-to guru means I use just about every gadget under the sun, so I can figure out how everything works. I work from a Lenovo ThinkPad running Windows 11, but also have a very large Dell Inspiron 17 3000 and Apple silicon MacBook. I have a Google Pixel 6a for personal use and use a Galaxy Z Flip 4 for additional Samsung-related testing. For iOS coverage, an iPhone 13 mini works like a charm, though it's already becoming a little long in the tooth.
My desktop situation includes a dual monitor setup with a modest Acer monitor. I also use a Logitech vertical mouse (who can use these ThinkPad trackpads) and a Havit keyboard (my first mechanical keyboard; I love it but my wife hates it!). I'm a recent convert from wired headphones; I have Anker Soundcore Liberty Air wireless earbuds for personal use and have taken to the Sennheiser HD 450BT headphones for work.
Whenever I have a second to myself, I'm probably gaming on my Nintendo Switch 2, Steam Deck, or Xbox Series S. I also still have a bunch of classic consoles lying around as well.

カブスからフリーエージェント（FA）となった今永昇太投手が、早くも2027年シーズンに向けて始動した。米国のアスリート向けトレーニング施設「Cressey Sports Performance（CSP）」が13日（日本時間14日）、YouTubeで動画を公開。フロリダの施設でトレーニングを行った今永の様子を伝えている。
■熱心にディスカッションする姿も
CSPは、アスリートのトレーニングやパフォーマンス向上を専門とする施設で、野球選手の投球や打撃の分析も行っている。今永は2025年10月にも同施設を訪れ、投球分析を実施。MLB公式サイトが当時の取り組みを報じた。そして今回、CSPの創業者エリック・クレッシー氏が自身のYouTubeチャンネルで動画を公開。今永のトレーニングの様子を伝えている。
今回の訪問では、投球時の身体の動きを捉える「モーションキャプチャー」や地面にかかる力を計測する「フォースプレート」、さらにボールを握る際のグリップ圧を測定する機器などを使用。CSPは「収集したデータを2027年に向けたトレーニングや投球プランの作成に活用する」と説明している。
今季の今永は32試合に先発し、11勝10敗、防御率3.77を記録。ポストシーズンでは登板機会が訪れることなくチームは敗れ去った。来季の所属先は決まっていないが、すでに新たなシーズンを見据えて動き始めている。

"We didn't expect to be in this situation, this position. But this one sucks," Hernández said, per Santiago Gil Sam.

Steering the ship for Los Angeles tonight is Tyler Glasnow, who helped the club clinch the NLDS over the Braves. Rookie Shane Drohan (7-5, 4.19 ERA) will be on the hill for the Brew Crew.

item.content:encoded:
The Philadelphia Phillies were eliminated from the MLB playoffs in the National League Wild Card Round.
The Atlanta Braves beat the Phillies 2-1 in the Wild Card Series at Truist Park.
The Braves have since been eliminated. Currently the Milwaukee Brewers hold a 3-0 lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series, and the Cleveland Guardians hold a 2-1 lead over the Tampa Bay Rays in the American League Championship Series.
Amid the ALCS and NLCS, Phillies president of baseball operations Dave Dombrowski met with the media. During the session, Dombrowski announced news involving Bryce Harper and Kyle Schwarber.
Philadelphia Phillies Announce Bryce Harper, Kyle Schwarber Updates After Playoff Elimination
ATLANTA, GEORGIA – SEPTEMBER 30: Kyle Schwarber #12 of the Philadelphia Phillies celebrates a home run with Bryce Harper #3 of the Philadelphia Phillies against the Atlanta Braves during the eighth inning in game two of the National League Wild Card Series at Truist Park on September 30, 2026 in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by Kevin C. Cox/Getty Images)
Dombrowski said that Harper will be the full-time first baseman in 2027, according to Justin Heinze of Patch.com.
The Phillies’ POBO also said that Schwarber is expected to get more reps at first base to help manage Harper’s workload.
PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA – MAY 06: Bryce Harper #3 high fives Kyle Schwarber #12 of the Philadelphia Phillies after a run in the eighth inning against the Athletics at Citizens Bank Park on May 06, 2026 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. (Photo by Emilee Chinn/Getty Images)
Harper began the 2026 season as the Phillies’ starting first baseman.
However, the Phillies had Harper play some right field, his old position, after they acquired second baseman Luis Arraez at the trade deadline.
SEATTLE, WASHINGTON – AUGUST 25: Bryce Harper #3 of the Philadelphia Phillies makes a catch for an out during the eighth inning against the Seattle Mariners at T-Mobile Park on August 25, 2026 in Seattle, Washington. (Photo by Steph Chambers/Getty Images)
Acquiring Arraez led to Bryson Stott moving to third base and Alec Bohm taking more reps at first base.
The Arraez acquisition also led to Schwarber getting some reps at first base. The primary DH appeared in eight games at DH this past season. He also appeared in two games at left field.
Looking at Bryce Harper’s 2026 Season
NEW YORK, NEW YORK – JUNE 27: Bryce Harper #3 of the Philadelphia Phillies catches a throw to first during the first inning against the New York Mets at Citi Field on June 27, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Caleb Bowlin/Getty Images)
Harper posted 3.3 fWAR and a .269/.380/.485 (135 wRC+) slash line with 29 home runs and 87 RBI over 162 games in 2026.
Defensively, Harper posted 0 Defensive Runs Saved and -5 Outs Above Average over 923 2/3 innings at first base. In right field, Harper recorded -5 DRS and -3 OAA over 363 2/3 innings.
Harper went 3-for-13 with a home run and a double in the Wild Card Series against Atlanta.
Looking at Kyle Schwarber’s 2026 Season
ATLANTA, GEORGIA – OCTOBER 01: Kyle Schwarber #12 of the Philadelphia Phillies walks to first base against the Atlanta Braves during the fourth inning in game three of the National League Wild Card Series at Truist Park on October 01, 2026 in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by Kevin C. Cox/Getty Images)
Schwarber posted 2.9 fWAR and a .232/.354/.503 (130 wRC+) slash line with 45 home runs and 97 RBI over 156 regular-season games in 2026.
During the Wild Card Series, Schwarber went 4-for-11 with a home run and two walks.

item.title: [FOX Sports] Dodgers Move Shohei Ohtani Back To Leadoff With Season On Line In NLCS Game 4
item.description: Dodgers Move Shohei Ohtani Back To Leadoff With Season On Line In NLCS Game 4 One loss from elimination, the Los Angeles Dodgers restored Shohei Ohtani to the top of the batting order for Game 4 of the National League Championship Series on Thursday night. Ohtani batted sixth in a 6-2 loss on Wednesday
item.content:encoded:
Dodgers Move Shohei Ohtani Back To Leadoff With Season On Line In NLCS Game 4
One loss from elimination, the Los Angeles Dodgers restored Shohei Ohtani to the top of the batting order for Game 4 of the National League Championship Series on Thursday night.
The Dodgers trailed the Milwaukee Brewers 3-0 in the best-of-seven series, and needed to four straight wins to reach the World Series and keep alive their bid for a third consecutive championship.
Ohtani batted sixth in a 6-2 loss on Wednesday night, the lowest he's hit since joining the Dodgers ahead of the 2024 season. He was 1 for 2 with a walk to raise his batting average to .182.
"Just seeing the work the last couple days, I like where his head is at," manager Dave Roberts said before the game. "I liked the at-bats yesterday. Obviously we haven’t performed the way that we’re capable of, so to kind of shake it up a little bit but something that’s of somewhat normalcy that our guys are used to."
(Photo by Sean M. Haffey/Getty Images)
Ohtani typically leads off the order but has been dropped lower while struggling with injuries to his left knee and right biceps for the last few months. Roberts didn't tell Ohtani about the change before posting the lineup.
Roberts said Ohtani has given him reasons to believe in the four-time MVP, citing Ohtani staying until 9 p.m. on Tuesday to work on his swing and his improved at-bat quality.
"Baking all that in, I felt absolutely, put him at the top," he said. "I feel good about him taking five at-bats and giving us our best chance to win and produce runs."
Roberts tweaked the entire lineup after Wednesday's loss put the Dodgers on the brink of elimination. Mookie Betts, who led off in Game 3, was bumped to No. 2, while Freddie Freeman moved to No. 3.
Will Smith, whose offensive struggles mirrored Ohtani's, moved up to fourth from seventh. Smith doubled in the sixth inning, when the Dodgers briefly took a 2-1 lead.
"I thought Will took very good at-bats, big hit yesterday," Roberts said. "He’s been in big spots."
Kyle Tucker hit fifth, while Teoscar Hernandez went from third to sixth. Miguel Rojas hit seventh and Andy Pages dropped to eighth from fifth.
Kiké Hernández, who came off the bench in Game 3, hit ninth, with regular third baseman Max Muncy available to come off the bench for Rojas or Kiké Hernández.
Reporting by The Associated Press.

item.title: [MLB.com] LIVE: Brewers-Dodgers NLCS Game 4 (FS1/FOX One)
item.dc:creator: Sonja Chen; Adam McCalvy; AJ Cassavell
item.description: Milwaukee brings a commanding 3-0 lead into Game 4 of the National League Championship Series on Thursday night. But the Dodgers are the champs until they’re not, and they’ve faced plenty of adversity on their way to World Series titles in each of the past two seasons. Never like this though. In all best-of-seven postseason series, teams with a 3-0 lead have gone on to win that series 41 times out of 42 -- with 32 of those series ending as sweeps. Only two teams have ever even forced a Game 7 af
item.content:encoded:
Milwaukee brings a commanding 3-0 lead into Game 4 of the National League Championship Series on Thursday night. But the Dodgers are the champs until they’re not, and they’ve faced plenty of adversity on their way to World Series titles in each of the past two seasons.
Never like this though. In all best-of-seven postseason series, teams with a 3-0 lead have gone on to win that series 41 times out of 42 -- with 32 of those series ending as sweeps. Only two teams have ever even forced a Game 7 after trailing 3-0, and only the 2004 Red Sox, in the ALCS against the Yankees, have come all the way back to win.
“It's certainly possible,” said Dodgers manager Dave Roberts, himself a fabled part of that Red Sox rally. “I've lived it. And I think the thing is that our guys have been battle-tested. … It's an elimination game. We've played in a lot of elimination games. We've just got to get a win.”
While the Dodgers chase baseball history, the Brewers can make a bit of their own with a win on Thursday. A year ago, they were swept by the Dodgers in the very same round. If they can return the favor, they would become the first team to be swept out of the playoffs, only to sweep the same team -- in any postseason series -- a year later. But they’re not getting ahead of themselves.
“We have yet to complete anything,” Brewers outfielder Jackson Chourio said through an interpreter. “The job's not finished for us. So we have to come with the same mentality. Which is to win.”
Here’s what you need to know about Game 4:
When is the game and how can I watch it?
Game 4 is currently airing nationally on FS1.
All series are available in the US on MLB.TV with authentication to a participating Pay TV provider. Games also are available live internationally, although not in Canada. Sportsnet is MLB's exclusive English language broadcaster in Canada for every Postseason game, while TVA Sports will be covering the entire AL Postseason and the World Series in French and Broadcaster RDS will cover the entire NL Postseason in French.
The Brewers picked Drohan from among a plethora of fresh options to start what amounts to a bullpen game. Left-handers Kyle Harrison and Drohan and right-hander Chad Patrick have been on the roster for both the NLDS and NLCS, but have yet to pitch in any of the Brewers’ first seven games. Midseason pickup Dustin May, the former Dodger who won a World Series ring with L.A. in 2020, pitched an inning in NLCS Game 2 on what would have been a bullpen day had he been lined up to start Thursday. They are all options to come in behind Drohan, who had a 4.19 ERA in 33 games/19 starts and shifted to the bullpen late in the season when he came upon a loose innings limit. He thrived in short stints, posting a 1.47 ERA as a reliever. It will be his career postseason debut.
The Dodgers' 7-0 postseason record when Glasnow pitches is more of a quirk than anything else, but the right-hander has gotten the results to back it up. In four starts and three relief appearances, Glasnow has recorded a 1.73 ERA (five earned runs in 26 innings). Glasnow had command issues when he last pitched against the Braves in NLDS Game 4 -- issuing five walks -- but limited the damage to one run in 4 2/3 innings.
What are the starting lineups?
Brewers: The lineup the Brewers used against right-hander Yoshinobu Yamamoto in Game 2 produced the second postseason game in franchise history in which five different players tallied multiple hits. Against Glasnow in Game 4, they hope for a similar result with the same group.
Dodgers: Not only are the Dodgers sticking with Shohei Ohtani despite his lingering right biceps and left knee issues, they're bumping him up to leadoff for a must-win game. He and a scuffling Will Smith -- batting cleanup for Game 4 -- were dropped in the lineup in the past couple games, but the fact that both contributed to L.A.'s lone run-scoring rally in Game 3 likely played a role in Roberts' decision to elevate them Thursday.
How will the bullpens line up after the starter?
Brewers: Right-handed setup man Abner Uribe, who has appeared in each of the first seven games of the postseason, finally wilted a bit in Game 3, walking three batters ahead of Smith’s two-run double in the sixth inning. But left-hander DL Hall kept the game on track by stopping the rally there and recording seven enormous outs. Then Trevor Megill logged a four-out save. That’s a lot of work for those last two arms, so lefty Aaron Ashby figures to play a prominent role in Game 4 if the score is tight.
Dodgers: It's all hands on deck, with the possible exception of Justin Wrobleski, who threw 32 pitches to cover the final 1 2/3 innings of Game 3. Roberts made a point of saying that he will get closer Edwin Díaz --- the only Dodgers reliever who has not pitched this series -- into Game 4.
Any injuries of note?
Brewers: None.
Dodgers: Ohtani (right biceps, left knee) and Freeman (right knee) are managing lingering injuries. World Series hero Will Klein (right elbow discomfort) has faced hitters, but he has not pitched in a game since July 31 and is viewed as more of a depth option. Blake Treinen (right shoulder inflammation) is unlikely to pitch this postseason.
Who is hot and who is not?
Brewers: Chourio’s .642 OPS in this postseason doesn’t tell anything about his impact. His leadoff home run in Game 3 marked his second homer of the 2026 postseason and sixth of his career, breaking a brief tie with William Contreras for the most homers in Brewers’ postseason history. Three of them have led off a postseason game, which matched Hall of Famer Derek Jeter, Jimmy Rollins and Ohtani for the second-most in history, trailing only Kyle Schwarber, who has five leadoff home runs in the postseason. And with his 18th career postseason RBI, Chourio also broke a tie with Hall of Famer Andruw Jones for the most postseason RBIs prior to a player’s 23rd birthday. … With his eighth-inning base hit, Contreras became the first Brewers player with 10 hits in this postseason.
Dodgers: Tucker (.304) has consistently swung the bat well through seven games, but he has been the exception to the rule for a cold Dodgers offense. In Game 3, Ohtani (113.5 mph single) and Smith (two-run double) showed some positive signs, but they have been L.A.'s most notable slumping bats this postseason.
Anything else fans might want to know?
•  Orel Hershiser and Mike Scioscia will throw out the ceremonial first pitch and say, "It's time for Dodger baseball!" as part of the pregame ceremonies.
• According to the Elias Sports Bureau, this is the eighth time two teams met in the postseason one year after one swept the other in the previous postseason. The only team to be swept and then win a rematch the following postseason is the 1923 Yankees, who won that year's World Series over the New York Giants in six games.
• Brewers owner Mark Attanasio said it struck him that it’s been 44 years since the Brewers made it to the World Series, and 44 is one of the franchise’s retired numbers for Hall of Famer Hank Aaron. This year marked the 50th anniversary of Aaron’s 755th and final home run, which he hit while playing for the Brewers in 1976.
• This marks the sixth time a team has taken a 3-0 series lead against the reigning World Series champion in a best-of-seven series. Four of the previous five -- 1990 WS, Reds vs A’s; 1966 WS, Orioles vs Dodgers; 1963 WS, Dodgers vs Yankees; 1914 WS, Boston Braves vs Philadelphia Athletics -- ended in a sweep. The other (2017 NLCS, Dodgers vs Cubs) concluded with the Dodgers winning in five games.

item.title: [laist.com] Dodgers down 3-0 to Brewers in NLCS and must win 4 in a row for chance at 3rd straight championship
item.dc:creator: Megan Garvey
item.description: Dodgers down 3-0 to Brewers in NLCS and must win 4 in a row for chance at 3rd straight championship The star-studded Los Angeles Dodgers, so used to winning year after year, find themselves in unfamiliar territory lately — on the brink of playoff elimination. The two-time defending World Series champions are aiming to become the first National League team to win a third straight title and the first club to three-peat since the New York Yankees from 1998-2000. But that seems increasingly unlikely
item.content:encoded:
Dodgers down 3-0 to Brewers in NLCS and must win 4 in a row for chance at 3rd straight championship
The star-studded Los Angeles Dodgers, so used to winning year after year, find themselves in unfamiliar territory lately — on the brink of playoff elimination.
The two-time defending World Series champions are aiming to become the first National League team to win a third straight title and the first club to three-peat since the New York Yankees from 1998-2000.
But that seems increasingly unlikely.
The Dodgers are facing a 3-0 deficit against Milwaukee in the National League Championship Series after losing 6-2 on Wednesday. They’ll need to win four games in a row to advance, starting Thursday in Game 4 at Dodger Stadium.
“It looks like we’re going to have to make a little more history along the way if we want to accomplish that,” third baseman Max Muncy said. “We still have the pitching staff to be able to do it. We just have to get some hits.”
Offense has been sparse in the postseason. The Dodgers are 3 for 32 with runners in scoring position overall and 1 for 14 against the Brewers. Los Angeles cranked out 204 homers in the regular season — seventh in MLB — but have none so far in the NLCS.
“It’s just this whole series they’ve outslugged us, outhit us,” manager Dave Roberts said. “We’ve got to get a lead and find a way to tack on.”
The Dodgers scored twice in the sixth inning to take a 2-1 lead in Game 3 before pinch-hitter Kiké Hernández came up with runners on second and third and one out. But he struck out swinging, and Tommy Edman took a called third strike to end the inning.
“That was the game right there,” Hernández said. “We need to put the ball in play. I struck out and gave Tommy a way harder job with two outs. I have had two of the biggest at-bats in the series for our team and I haven’t been able to come through. I just need to do my job.”
Tyler Glasnow is scheduled to pitch Thursday for the Dodgers, who are 44-42 in postseason elimination games. If they can find a way to win, they would host Game 5 on Friday.
“We’ve never been in this big of a hole,” Hernández said, “but we’ve had our backs against the wall plenty of times before, and we’ve come out of it. We’re just trying to do it one more time.”
Except none of the Dodgers’ hitters are doing much of anything. Kyle Tucker, who struggled mightily in the regular season, has been a bright spot. He’s batting .304 after going 1 for 3 on Wednesday.
But the top of the lineup — Mookie Betts, Freddie Freeman and Teoscar Hernández — was a combined 1 for 11 in Game 3, when the Dodgers totaled five hits.
The deepest slumps involve four-time MVP Shohei Ohtani and catcher Will Smith. Ohtani was 1 for 2, raising his average to .182 a year after being MVP of the NLCS sweep against the Brewers. Smith was 1 for 4 with a two-run double, but his average is far south of the Mendoza Line at .074.
In Game 2, the Dodgers mustered just three hits in a 7-4 loss.
The only team in major league history to come back from a 3-0 deficit to win a best-of-seven postseason series was the 2004 Boston Red Sox, who got a gutsy stolen base from Roberts to spark their comeback against the New York Yankees in the AL Championship Series.
Roberts was asked if he might reminisce with his Dodgers players about that before Thursday’s game.
“I don’t think so. I think they’ve seen the documentary. They know it can happen,” he said.

item.content:encoded:
As summer comes to a close and the air turns crisp, you know what's coming: the MLB Playoffs. The NFL season is already underway, and if you're also a baseball lover, this next month is essential viewing. The MLB has been through a number of changes in recent years. From the universal DH and the pitch clock to video replay and an automated strike zone, baseball may look very different if you haven't been paying attention.
Today, the Guardians will face the Rays, and the Dodgers will go head-to-head against the Brewers in the best-of-seven Championship series. Which teams will come out on top? Here's how you can watch live.
What Time Is the Tampa Bay Rays vs. Cleveland Guardians Game?
Today's game between the Tampa Bay Rays and the Cleveland Guardians will take place on Thursday, October 15 at 1 p.m. ET. The game was moved from 6 p.m. to 1 p.m. due to expected rain this evening.
How to Watch the Tampa Bay Rays vs. Cleveland Guardians?
Tonight's Rays vs. Guardians game will air on TBS and HBO Max. This year, the American League Division Series games will be broadcast on TBS, while the National League games will be on Fox and FS1. You can also watch them with a live TV or sports streaming subscription from DirecTV, Fox One, Fubo, HBO Max, Hulu, Sling, Sportsnet+ (if you're in Canada), or YouTube TV.
How to Watch the Rays vs. the Guardians for Free
If you don't want to subscribe to any of the above platforms, you may be able to sign up for a few free trials to gain access to this weekend's games. Fox One and Hulu offer three-day trials, DirecTV and Fubo offer five days, and YouTube TV gives you 10 days for free.
2026 MLB Playoffs Game Schedule
MLB's expanded postseason means more teams on the playoff schedule. Things started off with the best-of-three Wild Card Series, where the Braves, Padres, White Sox, and Yankees advanced. The best-of-five Division Series put them up against the Los Angeles Dodgers, Milwaukee Brewers, Cleveland Guardians, and Tampa Bay Rays, respectively. All of whom managed to advance
Now, the Rays and Guardians and Dodgers and Brewers meet in the best-of-seven Championship Series to determine the best team in each league. The winner from each league will then advance to a best-of-seven World Series to begin on October 23. Who will make it all the way?
Los Angeles Dodgers vs. Milwaukee Brewers - MIL lead 3-0
- Game 4 on October 15 @ 9 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1
- Game 5 on October 16 @ 9 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1*
- Game 6 on October 18 @ 8 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1*
- Game 7 on October 19 @ 8 p.m. ET - Fox/FS1*
Cleveland Guardians vs. Tampa Bay Rays - CLE leads 1-1
- Game 3 on October 15 @ 1 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max
- Game 4 on October 16 @ 6 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max
- Game 5 on October 17 @ 8 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max*
- Game 6 on October 19 @ 5 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max*
- Game 7 on October 20 @ 8 p.m. ET - TBS/HBO Max*
*if necessary
How to Stream the 2026 MLB Playoffs
This year's MLB postseason is stretched across multiple networks and streaming services. All Wild Card Series games for the American League and National League were broadcast on NBC, NBCSN, and Peacock. Additional rounds will be on other networks. ALDS and ALCS games are on TBS/TruTV and HBO Max, while NLDS and NLCS games are on Fox/FS1. For the World Series, all games will be broadcast on Fox and the Fox One streaming service.
- DirecTV: DirecTV's MySports base pack costs $45 per month for the first six months to see every game on Fox, FS1, NBC, and TBS/TruTV.
- Fox One: Fox's own streaming app lets you watch the NLDS, NLCS, and World Series on Fox and FS1 for $20 per month.
- Fubo: Fubo's Sports plan costs $45.99 for the first month to watch the Wild Card Series, NLDS, NLCS, and World Series on Fox, FS1, and NBC/NBCSN.
- HBO Max: If you pay for the $18.49-per-month HBO Max Standard, you'll be able to watch the ALDS and ALCS games on TBS/TruTV.
- Hulu: For $90 per month, you can watch every game on Fox, FS1, NBC, TBS, and TruTV.
- Peacock: Instead of a live TV service, you'd need to pay $10.99 per month for Peacock Premium to see the Wild Card Series games.
- Sling: The $60.99-per-month Sling Orange & Blue bundle will let you watch the ALDS and ALCS on TBS/TruTV and the NLDS and NLCS on FS1. Day Passes are also available for Sling Orange, allowing you to watch games on TBS for up to seven days.
- Sportsnet+ (Canada only): The $30-per-month Standard tier lets you watch every postseason game.
- YouTube TV: Though the standard plan for YouTube TV costs $83 per month, you can actually now pay for the cheaper $65 Sports package to see all games on Fox, FS1, NBC/NBCSN, and TBS/TruTV.
Can I Watch Postseason Games on MLB.TV?
Are you already an MLB.TV subscriber? You can watch the Division Series, Championship Series, and World Series games through MLB's own streaming service—but there's a catch. To watch on MLB.TV, you'll first need to authenticate through a participating pay TV provider. It's such a sticking point that it makes the entire question moot. If you already have a TV provider, then you wouldn't need to use a streaming service. If you don't already have an MLB.TV subscription, don't pay for one now.
How can I listen to the 2026 postseason?
You can also listen to the games via ESPN Radio.
Which Teams Are In the Playoffs?
Since MLB expanded its postseason picture in 2022, a total of 12 teams make the playoffs each year. That includes six teams per league, including the three division winners and three Wild Card teams.
- American League Division Winners: Tampa Bay Rays (1), Cleveland Guardians (2), Houston Astros (3)
- American League Wild Card: New York Yankees (4), Boston Red Sox (5), Chicago White Sox (6)
- National League Division Winners: Milwaukee Brewers (1), Los Angeles Dodgers (2), Atlanta Braves (3)
- National League Wild Card: Chicago Cubs (4), Philadelphia Phillies (5), San Diego Padres (6)
Upgrade Your Streaming Experience
If you decide to watch the MLB postseason, there's still time to get a big-screen television for viewing this beautiful game. Pro tip: Turn on your TV's motion-smoothing option for the best picture while watching sports. Just remember to turn it off before watching other TV shows and movies to avoid the awful "soap opera" effect.
About Our Expert
As PCMag's editor of how to content, I have to cover a wide variety of topics and also make our stories accessible to everyday users. Considering my history as a technical writer, copywriter, and all-around freelancer covering baseball, comics, and more at various outlets, I am used to making myself into an expert.
I believe tech corporations are bad, but you might as well know how to use technology in everyday life. Want more how to content delivered right to your inbox? Sign up for the tips and tricks newsletter that I curate three times a week.
My job as how-to guru means I use just about every gadget under the sun, so I can figure out how everything works. I work from a Lenovo ThinkPad running Windows 11, but also have a very large Dell Inspiron 17 3000 and Apple silicon MacBook. I have a Google Pixel 6a for personal use and use a Galaxy Z Flip 4 for additional Samsung-related testing. For iOS coverage, an iPhone 13 mini works like a charm, though it's already becoming a little long in the tooth.
My desktop situation includes a dual monitor setup with a modest Acer monitor. I also use a Logitech vertical mouse (who can use these ThinkPad trackpads) and a Havit keyboard (my first mechanical keyboard; I love it but my wife hates it!). I'm a recent convert from wired headphones; I have Anker Soundcore Liberty Air wireless earbuds for personal use and have taken to the Sennheiser HD 450BT headphones for work.
Whenever I have a second to myself, I'm probably gaming on my Nintendo Switch 2, Steam Deck, or Xbox Series S. I also still have a bunch of classic consoles lying around as well.

item.content:encoded:
Los Los Angeles Dodgers afrontan el Juego 4 de la Serie de Campeonato de la Liga Nacional con la obligación de vencer a los Milwaukee Brewers para evitar la eliminación en los MLB Playoffs 2026. Tras caer en los tres primeros encuentros, la novena angelina regresa al Dodger Stadium sin margen de error, ante un rival que ha capitalizado su ventaja y está a un triunfo de conquistar el banderín de la Liga Nacional. Los Brewers buscarán cerrar la serie como visitantes, mientras que los Dodgers necesitan una actuación contundente para extender la eliminatoria y mantener sus aspiraciones de alcanzar la Serie Mundial.
En Estados Unidos, el cuarto partido se transmitirá por FS1 y FOX Deportes, con FOX One como alternativa para seguirlo por streaming. Los aficionados podrán elegir la señal en inglés o la cobertura en español para acompañar un encuentro que puede definir el futuro de los Dodgers en la postemporada. El primer lanzamiento está programado para las 8:00 p. m. ET (5:00 p. m. PT) de este jueves 15 de octubre.
En México, la transmisión de Dodgers vs. Brewers estará disponible a través de FOX Plus y FOX One. El encuentro comenzará a las 6:00 p. m., tiempo del centro de México, y los aficionados podrán seguir el desarrollo del Juego 4 por las señales y plataformas correspondientes a este mercado.
En el resto de Latinoamérica, los seguidores de las Grandes Ligas podrán ver el partido por ESPN 3 y Disney+ Premium. En Venezuela, la cobertura estará a cargo de Televen e IVC, mientras que MLB.TV ofrecerá una alternativa para los aficionados de otros países. Los horarios varían según el territorio: en Perú, Colombia, Ecuador y Panamá el encuentro comenzará a las 7:00 p. m.; en Argentina, Chile, Paraguay, Uruguay y Brasil, a las 9:00 p. m.; y en Bolivia, República Dominicana y Puerto Rico, a las 8:00 p. m.

item.content:encoded:
カブスとの５年契約が今季限りで満了となる鈴木誠也外野手（３２）に熱視線だ。安定した打撃に加え、守備力の向上でヤンキースのアーロン・ジャッジ外野手（３４）に代わる右翼のレギュラー候補として期待されている。
今季の鈴木は１４３試合の出場で打率２割７分、２６本塁打、８６打点、ＯＰＳ０・８４１の好成績。４年連続で２０発超えを果たしただけでなく、１４日（日本時間１５日）に発表されたゴールドグラブ賞の右翼手部門で初めて最終候補に選出された。以前は守備に対するチーム内の評価を得られず、ＤＨ専任となる時期もあったことを考えれば大躍進だ。
こうした攻守にわたる活躍があるからこそ他球団も放ってはおかない。米老舗誌「スポーツ・イラストレイテッド」の電子版「ＯＮ ＳＩ」は、ヤンキースの外野手の補強候補の一人として鈴木の名前を挙げた。しかもメジャー屈指の強打者・ジャッジの〝後釜〟という位置づけだ。
同誌は今季の鈴木を「彼のすべてが結実した年だった」と絶賛した上で「ケガに悩まされたシーズンを経て、ジャッジは今後、必然的に指名打者（ＤＨ）としての役割に限定されるだろう。２０２６年の鈴木がどれほど素晴らしい活躍を見せたかを考えれば、ヤンキースがこの日本人強打者を獲得できれば、ジャッジが去った後の外野陣は極めて充実した布陣となるだろう」と占った。
今季のジャッジは４月に右肋骨を疲労骨折。長期離脱を経て復帰したものの、９月に今度は右ふくらはぎの筋損傷で離脱した。そしてポストシーズンでは戦列に戻れないまま、チームは地区シリーズで敗退。ジャッジ自身にとって出場が６６試合にとどまったのは１年目の２０１６年、新型コロナの影響でシーズンが短縮された２０年を除いて最も少なく、来季はＤＨに転向すべきとの論調が強まっている。
ジャッジがＤＨで打撃に専念する代わりに右翼に空く穴を鈴木が埋めるという算段だ。その場合、「スペンサー・ジョーンズとコディ・ベリンジャーが中堅手と左翼手を務めることになる」とし「トレード期限直前に獲得した２選手（ルイス・ガルシアとエリオト・ラモス）と、ジアンカルロ・スタントンの全員を放出することになるだろう」と大胆な動きが必要との見方も示した。
年々進化を続ける鈴木の需要は高まるばかりとなりそうだ。

item.title: [si.com] Brewers Are Using Postseason Stage to Showcase MLB’s New Era
item.dc:creator: Tom Verducci
item.description: Los Angeles — When dynasties fall, it is not insurrection, nor jealousy, nor sloth that bring them down. It is the undefeated champion of the world, Father Time. We are watching the Los Angeles Dodgers age out.
